import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class Edge {
        int to, rev;
        long capacity, flow;
        Edge(int t, int r, long c) {
            to = t;
            rev = r;
            capacity = c;
            flow = 0;
        }
    }

    static class Dinic {
        int n, source, sink;
        List<List<Edge>> graph;
        int[] level, ptr;
        Queue<Integer> q;

        Dinic(int nodes, int s, int e) {
            n = nodes;
            source = s;
            sink = e;
            graph = new ArrayList<>();
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                graph.add(new ArrayList<>());
            }
            level = new int[n];
            ptr = new int[n];
            q = new LinkedList<>();
        }

        void addEdge(int u, int v, long cap) {
            graph.get(u).add(new Edge(v, graph.get(v).size(), cap));
            graph.get(v).add(new Edge(u, graph.get(u).size() - 1, 0));
        }

        boolean bfs() {
            Arrays.fill(level, -1);
            level[source] = 0;
            q.offer(source);
            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                int u = q.poll();
                for (Edge e : graph.get(u)) {
                    if (e.capacity - e.flow > 0 && level[e.to] == -1) {
                        level[e.to] = level[u] + 1;
                        q.offer(e.to);
                    }
                }
            }
            return level[sink] != -1;
        }

        long dfs(int u, long flow) {
            if (u == sink) return flow;
            for (int i = ptr[u]; i < graph.get(u).size(); i++) {
                ptr[u] = i;
                Edge e = graph.get(u).get(i);
                if (level[e.to] == level[u] + 1 && e.capacity - e.flow > 0) {
                    long pushed = dfs(e.to, Math.min(flow, e.capacity - e.flow));
                    if (pushed > 0) {
                        e.flow += pushed;
                        graph.get(e.to).get(e.rev).flow -= pushed;
                        return pushed;
                    }
                }
            }
            return 0;
        }

        long maxFlow() {
            long total = 0;
            while (bfs()) {
                Arrays.fill(ptr, 0);
                while (true) {
                    long pushed = dfs(source, Long.MAX_VALUE);
                    if (pushed <= 0) break;
                    total += pushed;
                }
            }
            return total;
        }
    }

    static int[][] distToFire = new int[150][150];
    static int[][] distToExit = new int[150][150];
    static int[][] cellIndex = new int[150][150];
    static int n, T;
    static String[] grid, exits;

    static List<int[]> neighbors(int r, int c) {
        List<int[]> res = new ArrayList<>();
        if (r + 1 < n) res.add(new int[]{r + 1, c});
        if (r - 1 >= 0) res.add(new int[]{r - 1, c});
        if (c + 1 < n) res.add(new int[]{r, c + 1});
        if (c - 1 >= 0) res.add(new int[]{r, c - 1});
        return res;
    }

    static void computeFireDist(int sr, int sc) {
        Queue<int[]> bfs = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(distToFire[i], -1);
        }
        distToFire[sr][sc] = 0;
        bfs.offer(new int[]{sr, sc});
        while (!bfs.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = bfs.poll();
            int r = cell[0], c = cell[1];
            for (int[] nb : neighbors(r, c)) {
                int nr = nb[0], nc = nb[1];
                if (grid[nr][nc] != 'Z' && !Character.isDigit(grid[nr].charAt(nc)) && distToFire[nr][nc] == -1) continue;
                if (distToFire[nr][nc] == -1 || distToFire[nr][nc] > distToFire[r][c] + 1) {
                    distToFire[nr][nc] = distToFire[r][c] + 1;
                    bfs.offer(new int[]{nr, nc});
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(grid[i].charAt(j)) && distToFire[i][j] == -1) {
                    distToFire[i][j] = T;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void computeExitDist(int sr, int sc) {
        Queue<int[]> bfs = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            Arrays.fill(distToExit[i], -1);
        }
        distToExit[sr][sc] = 0;
        bfs.offer(new int[]{sr, sc});
        while (!bfs.isEmpty()) {
            int[] cell = bfs.poll();
            int r = cell[0], c = cell[1];
            for (int[] nb : neighbors(r, c)) {
                int nr = nb[0], nc = nb[1];
                if (!Character.isDigit(grid[nr].charAt(nc)) || distToExit[nr][nc] != -1) continue;
                distToExit[nr][nc] = distToExit[r][c] + 1;
                bfs.offer(new int[]{nr, nc});
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        n = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        T = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        grid = new String[n];
        exits = new String[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            grid[i] = br.readLine();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            exits[i] = br.readLine();
        }

        int fireR = -1, fireC = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                cellIndex[i][j] = i * n + j + 1;
                if (grid[i].charAt(j) == 'Z') {
                    fireR = i;
                    fireC = j;
                }
            }
        }

        computeFireDist(fireR, fireC);

        int totalNodes = n * n * 2 + 2;
        int source = 0, sink = totalNodes - 1;
        Dinic flowNet = new Dinic(totalNodes, source, sink);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(grid[i].charAt(j))) {
                    int people = grid[i].charAt(j) - '0';
                    flowNet.addEdge(source, cellIndex[i][j], people);
                    computeExitDist(i, j);
                    for (int r = 0; r < n; r++) {
                        for (int c = 0; c < n; c++) {
                            if (Character.isDigit(exits[r].charAt(c)) && distToExit[r][c] != -1 &&
                                distToExit[r][c] <= distToFire[r][c] &&
                                distToExit[r][c] <= T) {
                                boolean allow = true;
                                if (distToExit[r][c] == distToFire[r][c]) {
                                    allow = false;
                                    for (int[] nb : neighbors(r, c)) {
                                        int nr = nb[0], nc = nb[1];
                                        if (distToExit[nr][nc] != -1 &&
                                            distToExit[nr][nc] < distToFire[nr][nc]) {
                                            allow = true;
                                            break;
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                                if (allow) {
                                    flowNet.addEdge(cellIndex[i][j], n * n + cellIndex[r][c], people);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                if (Character.isDigit(exits[i].charAt(j))) {
                    int capacity = exits[i].charAt(j) - '0';
                    flowNet.addEdge(n * n + cellIndex[i][j], sink, capacity);
                }
            }
        }

        System.out.println(flowNet.maxFlow());
    }
}
